name: MegaFon
verdict: The MegaFon mobile operator is 100% owned by USM Group, the private holding of Alisher Usmanov. Nothing found.
note: Owner attribution is from named press (The Moscow Times, Jan 2023; RBC, Feb 2023); MegaFon's own 2025 IFRS statements no longer name the controlling party (see owner note). Rating note: private owner; personal sanctions against Usmanov are not a record under METHOD.md, and no human-rights finding against MegaFon itself was found.
